task.description: ISS-0526: determine the correct destination/format for R-Co's real narrative UAT scenario corpus (tests/simulation/scenarios/*.yaml, 4 SwiftRoute + 4 Vortex + 3 Meridian) and design how UAT-RUNNER should consume it, then port the real content verbatim. R-Co is cloned read-only at /tmp/claude-1001/-home-tvolodi-workspace-letflow-1/272542c3-4900-4f18-9bc0-54eaccf87cff/scratchpad/r-co-src (commit d19bfec4a9ec492345346bfccd8e389bd9cd92db, from https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co) -- do NOT commit this clone or reference its local path in letflow, cite provenance by URL+sha instead. UAT-RUNNER's own instructions (.claude/agents/uat-runner.md) already explicitly defer this: 'The scenario corpus for the stage under test (location TBD by S7's own requirements -- see docs/migration/stage-7-simulation-uat-parity.md)' -- this issue is exactly that TBD being resolved. ORCH noted during discovery: letflow's existing web/tests/e2e/pipelines/*.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts files (sim-company-onboarding, sim-admin-processes, onboarding-wizard, admin-user-lifecycle) do NOT match the pipeline_test: filenames R-Co's real scenario YAMLs reference (e.g. a SwiftRoute file cites 'web/tests/e2e/pipelines/shipment-attach-delivery-note.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts', which does not exist in letflow's web/ tree) -- these are likely R-Co's own frontend's pipeline specs, not yet ported, a fact to account for in scoping rather than silently assume away. Read docs/agents/workflows/WF-05_uat_run.md and docs/migration/stage-7-simulation-uat-parity.md in full before designing.
